sources.title: pallavdwivedi/Weather-Robust-Object-Detection-on-BDD100K - GitHub
sources.snippet: Weather-Robust Vehicle Detection on BDD100K (YOLOv11) This project trains and evaluates a YOLOv11n-based vehicle detector (car, truck, bus) on a 10% subset of the BDD100K dataset, with a clear-weather baseline and mixed-weather testing using test-time augmentation (TTA).
